# 🚀 Getting Started ✨

### 🏁 Quick Start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/MidnightMarie9/midnight-ledger.git
cd midnight-ledger
npm install
npm run dev
```

### 📲 Install as PWA
1. Open: https://ai.studio/apps/7f0453b7-b342-442b-94e5-33cdef6ada62 💻
2. iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen 📱
3. Android: Menu → Install App 🤖

Installs as **MidnightLedger** 🌙 with purple icon 💜✨
